title: Indialite (K$_{0.12}$[Fe$_{2}$][Mg$_{0.85}$Fe$_{0.15}$]$_{2}$Al$_{3}$ $\cdot$ (Al,Si)$_{3}$(Si,Al)$_{12}$O$_{36}$ Structure
comments:
(Rastsvetaeva, 2014) calls this a Fe-analogue of Indialite, and the first mineral to be found in \href{current_web_home_dir/hexagonal_spacegroup.html#sg177}{space group $P622$ \#177}. 
 The Mg (2d) site is 85\% Mg and 15\% Fe.  The K (2e) site is only 6\% K, and the Si (12n) site is 70\% Si and 30\% Al, giving the final stoichiometry listed in the title. The ICSD lists three other structures in $P622$, all are equally complicated.
